please remember in prayer our young parishioners, family members and friends who are making
important choices and decisions at this time, having received exam results :
we pray, o lord, that they be guided by the holy spirit
as they seek to plan their future, whether
at school, in third-level education or in the workplace .
grant that the path they choose in life will bring them happiness and fulfilment .
may your love be upon them, o lord, as they place all their trust in you. amen.
we pray for the happy repose of the soul of michael harper, castlefin road, whose funeral mass
took place in castlederg on wednesday. we offer our sympathy and our prayerful support to his
family and to all who mourn his death. may he rest in peace.
